{{Quote|The Empire's greatest Sith alchemist, Lord Fulminiss. A Jedi knight on Voss deprived us of his genius.|[[Darth Acina]]|<ref name="Visions of Light and Darkness" />}}
During the [[Mission to Voss (Emperor's ritual crisis)|mission]] to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] from unleashing a plague of madness across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Dark Heart]] to confront Fulminiss alongside the [[Voss commandos|Voss Commando]] [[Tala-Reh]] and rescue the [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Valen-Da]].
